worldcombat.skill.shockwave.summary: A jolt that lands the instant it is fired, with no random accuracy roll: the current flashes along the straight line to the target, and the first body or block in the way is the real endpoint; it can be fired empty. A soaked or rain-wet target conducts it harder; an immune target takes nothing and a wall stops the current.
The current flashes along the straight line from the user to the target; the first body or block in the way is the endpoint. A non-ally hit takes about %1$s damage, and a soaked or rain-wet target takes %2$s more. An immune target takes nothing and a wall stops the current.
worldcombat.skill.shockwave.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.shockwave.use.0: A jolt that lands on the instant
worldcombat.skill.shockwave.use.1: Strike a soaked or rain-wet target
worldcombat.skill.shockwave.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of firing. Larger values open up further.
On: soaked targets, or targets standing in local rain, are fired at first, since water conducts the jolt harder. Off: order it like a plain ranged attack.
On: the user may leave its post to find a line of fire; off: it only fires from where it stands.
